title: Describe the video truthfully in its title and summary
statement: The name and description supplied for a video, in visible text and in any markup, describe the video that actually plays on the page and do not promise content it does not contain.
rationale: A description that overstates the video is a claim about the page's content that the page then fails to honour, and the mismatch is what a viewer discovers after committing to watch.
implementation: Take both values from the same record the page displays, so editing one changes both. An automated agent must not compose or extend a description of media it has not examined, and should report the missing value instead.

verification.method: Compare the marked-up name and description against the visible heading and summary on the same page and against the media the page embeds.

title: Publish a fetchable thumbnail for every indexable video
statement: Each video page references a still image representing the video at a URL that returns a successful response, is not blocked by a crawl directive, and meets the documented format and size expectations for video results.
rationale: The thumbnail is the only part of a video a search surface can show before playback, so a missing or unreachable one removes the visual the result would consist of.
implementation: Generate the still during upload processing and store its URL on the video record, so every consumer reads the same value. Confirm the asset path is not covered by a directive blocking the media directory.

verification.method: Request each declared thumbnail URL without cookies and record the status code, content type, and pixel dimensions returned.

sources.title: Video SEO best practices, thumbnail requirements

title: Populate VideoObject with accurate playback metadata
statement: The upload date, duration, and media or player location declared in the markup are read from the stored video record and match the media the page serves.
rationale: These values are what a consumer uses to decide whether the video is current and worth fetching, so a placeholder duration or a stale player location describes a video other than the one present.
implementation: Emit the values from the media record rather than from the template, formatting the duration with the interval notation the vocabulary specifies. Omit a property whose value is unknown instead of supplying a default.

verification.method: Compare each declared value against the stored media record and against the response returned by the declared media location.

title: Provide synchronized captions for meaningful spoken video
statement: Prerecorded video containing speech or other meaningful audio carries captions synchronised with the media through a caption track the player exposes, rather than a separate file the reader must find.
rationale: Without captions the spoken content is unavailable to anyone who cannot hear it or is watching without sound, and that content is often the entire substance of the page.
implementation: Attach the caption track to the player element so it is selectable during playback. Machine transcription may produce the first draft, but a person must correct it before publication, so an automated agent must not publish an unreviewed track.

verification.method: Confirm each video element exposes a caption track, fetch that track, and check its timings span the media duration.

title: Give each video its own indexable watch page
statement: A video the site wants found has a page whose primary subject is that video, where the player is visible without interaction, and that page is indexable and reachable through a crawlable link.
rationale: A video buried among several others on a listing page has no address of its own, so there is no URL a result could point at and no page whose text describes that video in particular.
implementation: Add a route per video that renders the player in the main content region, and link to it from the listing. Do not gate playback behind a click that also gates the player element itself.

verification.method: Fetch each video route and confirm the player element is present in the response, the page is indexable, and an internal link points at it.

caution: A dedicated indexable page is a documented prerequisite for video results. Whether a video appears in them is decided by the surface, and this control makes no claim about that outcome.

sources.title: Video SEO best practices, video page requirements
